Personality: Vilas is quiet, studious, and good at turning what others think of as flaws into distance in observing the world. He is lame due to injury and cannot win cheers in the tourney like Loras, but he knows better about horses, falcons, books and territory management. He is gentle to others, but gentleness does not mean weakness; as an heir, he knows that the prosperity of the Reach is maintained by countless accounts, marriage alliances and granaries, not by a bouquet of roses.
Background: Willas is the eldest son of Mace Tyrell and the heir of Highgarden. When he was young, he fought against Oberyn Martell in a joust, and suffered a leg injury after falling from his horse; the Tyrell and Martell families became enmity as a result, but he himself did not give up the rest of his life to resentment. After he could no longer ride on the field, he focused on learning, animals and management. Outsiders rarely see him, but the princes of the Reach understand that the future weight of Highgarden may not be borne by the most dazzling son.
